calculation.description: Fades recent asset returns, with stronger reversal when short-horizon volatility is elevated relative to its longer baseline; the three-observation mean reduces noise. All inputs are lagged completed daily observations.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.049561; ICIR 0.142332), 2023-2024 (0.036249; ICIR 0.104045), and 2025-2027 (0.025911; ICIR 0.077320). Predictive decay is visible beyond one day, so use as a short-horizon component rather than a standalone long-horizon signal.
